tasks.label: Check Local Endpoints
args: $urls=@('http://localhost:3000','http://localhost:3001/login','http://localhost:4000/health'); foreach($u in $urls){ try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 12; Write-Output "$u => $($r.StatusCode)" } catch { Write-Output "$u => FAIL: $($_.Exception.Message)" } }
